## Problem

What developer problem would this request solve?

## Proposed change

Describe the behavior or extension you would like to add or change.

## Flutter-specific value

Explain why this belongs in a curated Flutter and Dart extension pack and which tier it should belong to.

## Evidence and links

For extension additions, provide the exact `publisher.name` ID and direct Marketplace URL.
